post.description: Creates a new print job in PrintNode.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

printerId.description: The ID of the printer you want to print to.

contentType.description: One of pdf_uri, pdf_base64, raw_uri, or raw_base64.

content.description: A document URI or a base64-encoded document, depending on contentType.

source.description: Optional description of where the print job originated.

options.description: Optional object of PrintNode print options, such as copies, pages, duplex, paper, or bin.

expireAfter.description: Optional maximum number of seconds PrintNode should retain the print job before expiry.

qty.description: Optional number of times the print job should be delivered to the queue.

authentication.description: Optional HTTP Basic or Digest authentication object used when PrintNode must download the document from a protected URI.

value.description: ID of the created print job.
